name: support-targets
description: Explain why Zendesk tickets got an SLA target, which targets breached, and why SLA percentages differ from ticket counts. Use when you ask why a ticket got a target, why an SLA percentage differs from ticket counts, or which events caused a breach. For comment-based workflows; excludes live-chat and messaging reply events. Works with pasted policy text, report rows and readable exports. Not for live monitoring, account changes, ticket export generation or support reply drafting.
